workResult: Skill 03 completed source-bounded Deep Reading for both same-date selected objects and no separate Industry Architecture reading. Q-20260905-01 compared GitHub Copilot's official separation of approval assessment, approval capability, merge-requirement effect, administrator/file-path scope and commit freshness with OpenAI Codex maintainer commit 87628df77ab1a2622d1193ad835df02ced565bf2, which versions Guardian root-authorization evidence, cancels an allow when the evidence version changes, recovers required authorization context after compaction, marks missing required evidence incomplete, and strips parent-only approvals on worker fork. The bounded finding is that AI judgment, authorization evidence, scope, freshness and effective sign-off are distinct state dimensions; neither sample proves named human-principal identity, legal accountability or exactly-once downstream effects. Q-20260905-03 read the complete 15-page primary study and its public reproducibility repository for agentic Julia code generation on supercomputers. The study's autonomous plan-generate-test-refine loop catches many ordinary code errors, but implementations that pass small correctness tests later fail under larger workloads or parallelism with deadlocks, oversubscription, out-of-memory errors, crashes and timeouts. The evidence therefore separates functional correctness, agent-process evidence, operational failure envelope, performance/scalability and transfer/reproducibility. Its limits include one nondeterministic generation per model/problem/framework condition, local-generation versus target-HPC mismatch, no non-Julia/vendor-optimized ground truth, prompt-comparability trade-offs and incomplete cost measurement. Reading performed no Research Analysis, article writing, visualization, Production or Publication.
workResult_zh: Skill 03 已对两个同日 Selected Object 完成来源边界内的 Deep Reading，Industry Architecture 因明确 No Selection 未单独深读。Q-20260905-01 将 GitHub Copilot 官方合同中 Approval Assessment、Approval Capability、是否计入 Merge Requirement、管理员/文件路径 Scope 与 Commit Freshness 的分离，与 OpenAI Codex Maintainer Commit 87628df77ab1a2622d1193ad835df02ced565bf2 进行独立比较；Codex 对 Guardian Root-authorization Evidence 版本化，在 Evidence Version 改变时取消 Allow，在 Compaction 后恢复必需授权上下文，在必需证据缺失时标记 Incomplete，并在 Worker Fork 时剥离 Parent-only Approval。边界结论是：AI Judgment、Authorization Evidence、Scope、Freshness 与 Effective Sign-off 是不同状态维度；两个样本都不能证明 Named Human Principal Identity、Legal Accountability 或 Downstream Effect Exactly-once。Q-20260905-03 完整深读 15 页一手研究论文及其公开 Reproducibility Repository，研究对象是在 Supercomputer 上进行 Agentic Julia Code Generation。自主 Plan–Generate–Test–Refine Loop 能发现许多普通代码错误，但部分通过小规模 Correctness Test 的实现，在更大 Workload 或更高 Parallelism 下出现 Deadlock、Oversubscription、Out-of-memory、Crash 与 Timeout。因此评估证据应分开记录 Functional Correctness、Agent-process Evidence、Operational Failure Envelope、Performance/Scalability 与 Transfer/Reproducibility。研究边界包括：每个 Model/Problem/Framework 条件仅生成一次且具有非确定性、Local Generation 与 Target HPC 环境不一致、缺少 Non-Julia/Vendor-optimized Ground Truth、Prompt Comparability/Flexibility 取舍及 Cost Measurement 不完整。Reading 未执行 Research Analysis、文章写作、可视化、Production 或 Publication。
